originalIntent: Continuous questioning across every component of MOOR OS without an obligation to finish a funnel. Prioritize unheard components, allow a focused manual card funnel, preserve one canonical answer ledger with history and project-style save/export/restore, and refresh stale questions without discarding answers. Compile the entire current answer catalog through GPT, MUSE, COPI, LOCAL, NONE or OTHER. Export context to clipboard and accept each model’s JSON response in the bottom-right panel. Each model has one current opinion per component. Show five fixed model colors at the top, mix all submitted model opinion colors across the card surface, keep owner opinion as a bottom bar, and identify contradictions for owner resolution. Green means clarity/alignment, never permanent completion or implementation. Cadence is configurable; manual models use copy/paste and the local no-LLM compiler uses explicit constraints and learned owner resolutions.
pipeline: Derive card questions from contracts and architecture
Store canonical owner answers with revisions
Expose conflicts and choose next unanswered component

decisions.otherReviewer: Included in mixed surface and opinion inspector; not a sixth fixed top lane.
decisions.modelExecution: Copy/paste outside this page; NONE is a deterministic local compiler.
decisions.cadence: Open-page reminders and local NONE execution. Closed-page agent scheduling needs an external service.
decisions.questions: Stable IDs, preserved original answered prompts, contextual refresh for pending questions.
decisions.answers: One canonical ledger; restore replaces rather than merges current answers.
decisions.modelState: One replaceable opinion per model per card; snapshot guards prevent stale imports.
decisions.progress: Clarity and alignment, never permanent done or built.
